notes: Desktop 2.7.0 expands discovery from two to four sources by adding StartupJobs.cz and Indeed.cz alongside Jobs.cz and Prace.cz. The new sources have dedicated parsers, source toggles, Dashboard filters, cross-source deduplication, and a read-only Chromium discovery fallback when plain HTTP returns no parsable jobs. StartupJobs.cz and Indeed.cz are intentionally discovery-only in this release: high-scoring vacancies are shown as REVIEW and can be opened manually, but they cannot enter Queue application or Prepare now. Existing duplicate-submission protection and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.
